topics.title: Coursework
topics.summary: In programmes PSL operates directly, AI tools may be used only where the instructor authorises them, and their use must then be disclosed. Member institutions (ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and others) apply their own regulations; for example the CIENS centre at ENS-PSL allows AI only as occasional help (translation, document exploration, organising work) and bans AI-written text content.
topics.scope: Instructor authorisation under the 2026-27 regulation; member-institution rules.

claims.text: Université PSL's Règlement de la scolarité for 2026-2027 (adopted by the Board on 25 June 2026, replacing the June 2025 version with the same AI wording) states that, where an instructor authorises AI-based tools such as ChatGPT, their use must be explicitly disclosed like any source citation, and failure to disclose AI use is treated as plagiarism and sanctioned as such; a disciplinary procedure may follow, with sanctions up to exclusion (not automatic exclusion). The 2026 version applies to programmes operated directly by PSL (such as the Collège Sciences, Humanités et Société and the Paris School of AI); member institutions apply their own regulations, so it does not set course permissions across ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and other members.

claims.text: The AI charter of CIENS (an interdisciplinary centre of ENS-PSL) applies to CIENS students, teachers and researchers only. It allows generative AI as occasional help for translation, document exploration, exploratory document analysis or organising work, but prohibits producing false references, developing a research problem and scientific reasoning, writing the text content, and giving AI sensitive, protected or confidential information. Any AI use must be stated in a note or the body of the text, naming the tool and the nature of use; undeclared use may be treated as academic fraud and lead to disciplinary sanctions. These are unit-level rules, not PSL-wide rules.

claims.text: PSL's Charte du doctorat (June 2026, section 2.7) sets general recommendations on generative AI for doctoral candidates, some of which are mandatory. Generative AI is not prohibited in doctoral research, but its uses must be transparent, declared and critically assessed, and the candidate remains fully responsible for AI-obtained content. Candidates must insert a dated, signed 'Déclaration doctorale d'intégrité scientifique' (one to two pages) at the start of the thesis, stating which generative AI tools were used, for which tasks, their benefits, limits and risks, and any mitigation. Member institutions may set stricter rules, which prevail.

claims.text: The Dauphine-PSL library's research-integrity guidance advises keeping a critical approach to AI tools, not treating them as co-authors, and not using them to create scientific materials that could be falsified. claims.claimText: Université PSL's Règlement de la scolarité for 2026-2027 (adopted by the Board on 25 June 2026, replacing the June 2025 version with the same AI wording) states that, where an instructor authorises AI-based tools such as ChatGPT, their use must be explicitly disclosed like any source citation, and failure to disclose AI use is treated as plagiarism and sanctioned as such; a disciplinary procedure may follow, with sanctions up to exclusion (not automatic exclusion). The 2026 version applies to programmes operated directly by PSL (such as the Collège Sciences, Humanités et Société and the Paris School of AI); member institutions apply their own regulations, so it does not set course permissions across ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and other members.

claims.claimText: PSL's Charte du doctorat (June 2026, section 2.7) sets general recommendations on generative AI for doctoral candidates, some of which are mandatory. Generative AI is not prohibited in doctoral research, but its uses must be transparent, declared and critically assessed, and the candidate remains fully responsible for AI-obtained content. Candidates must insert a dated, signed 'Déclaration doctorale d'intégrité scientifique' (one to two pages) at the start of the thesis, stating which generative AI tools were used, for which tasks, their benefits, limits and risks, and any mitigation. Member institutions may set stricter rules, which prevail.

claims.claimText: The AI charter of CIENS (an interdisciplinary centre of ENS-PSL) applies to CIENS students, teachers and researchers only. It allows generative AI as occasional help for translation, document exploration, exploratory document analysis or organising work, but prohibits producing false references, developing a research problem and scientific reasoning, writing the text content, and giving AI sensitive, protected or confidential information. Any AI use must be stated in a note or the body of the text, naming the tool and the nature of use; undeclared use may be treated as academic fraud and lead to disciplinary sanctions. These are unit-level rules, not PSL-wide rules.

coursework.en: In programmes PSL operates directly, AI tools may be used only where the instructor authorises them, and their use must then be disclosed. Member institutions (ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and others) apply their own regulations; for example the CIENS centre at ENS-PSL allows AI only as occasional help (translation, document exploration, organising work) and bans AI-written text content.
coursework.zh: 在 PSL 直接运营的项目中，只有在教师授权时才可使用 AI 工具，且使用后必须披露。成员机构（高师、巴黎九大、巴黎矿业等）适用各自规则；例如高师 CIENS 中心只允许把 AI 作为临时辅助（翻译、文献探索、安排工作），并禁止用 AI 撰写正文。

exams.en: The reviewed PSL sources do not set a general AI rule for examinations beyond anti-fraud measures; follow each programme's exam rules and instructor authorisation. This is an evidence gap, not a permission.
exams.zh: 所审核的 PSL 来源除防作弊措施外，没有设定针对考试的一般 AI 规则；请遵守各项目的考试规定和教师授权。这是证据缺口，并非许可。

disclosure.en: Where an instructor authorises AI, its use must be disclosed explicitly like any source citation; undisclosed use is treated as plagiarism. Doctoral candidates must include a signed 'Déclaration doctorale d'intégrité scientifique' listing AI tools, tasks, benefits, limits and risks. CIENS requires AI use to be noted in a note or the text.
disclosure.zh: 教师授权使用 AI 时，须像引用任何来源一样明确披露；未披露的使用按剽窃处理。博士生须在论文中附签署的《博士科研诚信声明》，列明所用 AI 工具、任务、优缺点和风险。CIENS 要求在注释或正文中注明 AI 使用情况。

privacy_data.en: CIENS prohibits giving AI sensitive, protected or confidential information. Dauphine-PSL library guidance advises not sharing personal data with third parties and checking that generated text contains no personal data. No PSL-wide AI data rule was found in the reviewed sources.
privacy_data.zh: CIENS 禁止向 AI 提供敏感、受保护或机密信息。巴黎九大图书馆指引建议不要与第三方共享个人数据，并检查生成文本不含个人数据。所审核来源中未发现全 PSL 统一的 AI 数据规则。

approved_tools.en: No PSL-wide list of approved or licensed AI tools was found in the reviewed sources. ChatGPT is mentioned only as an example of an AI tool, not as a required or provided service.
approved_tools.zh: 所审核来源中未发现全 PSL 统一的获批或授权 AI 工具清单。ChatGPT 只是作为 AI 工具示例被提及，不是要求使用或学校提供的服务。

research_publication.en: Generative AI is not prohibited in PSL doctoral research, but uses must be transparent, declared and critically assessed; the candidate remains fully responsible and member institutions may set stricter rules. Dauphine-PSL library guidance recommends stating the tool, version and context, not treating AI as a co-author, and notes reproducibility risks; these are recommendations at a member institution.
research_publication.zh: PSL 博士研究不禁止使用生成式 AI，但使用必须透明、声明并接受批判性审视；博士生承担全部责任，成员机构可设更严格规则。巴黎九大图书馆指引建议注明工具、版本和使用背景，不将 AI 视为合著者，并提示可重复性风险；这些属于成员机构的建议。

academic_integrity.en: Failure to disclose AI use is treated and sanctioned as plagiarism. On suspicion, the instructor informs the programme management and a disciplinary procedure may follow, with sanctions up to exclusion (not automatic). At CIENS, undeclared AI use may be treated as academic fraud.
academic_integrity.zh: 未披露 AI 使用按剽窃认定和处罚。出现怀疑时，教师须告知项目管理团队，可能启动纪律程序，处分最高可至开除（并非自动）。在 CIENS，未声明的 AI 使用可能被视为学术欺诈。

academic_integrity.en: Failure to disclose AI use is treated and sanctioned as plagiarism. On suspicion, the instructor informs the programme management and a disciplinary procedure may follow, with sanctions up to exclusion (not automatic). At CIENS, undeclared AI use may be treated as academic fraud.
academic_integrity.zh: 未披露 AI 使用按剽窃认定和处罚。出现怀疑时，教师须告知项目管理团队，可能启动纪律程序，处分最高可至开除（并非自动）。在 CIENS，未声明的 AI 使用可能被视为学术欺诈。

teaching_guidance.en: University-wide teaching frameworks, instructional guidance on AI pedagogical integration, and syllabus design recommendations for faculty are not established in current reviewed public sources.
teaching_guidance.zh: 全校性教学框架、关于 AI 教学融合的教师指导以及课程大纲设计建议在当前已审核的公开来源中尚未确立。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: No central pedagogical guidance found in reviewed PSL regulations or member unit charters.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 在已审核的 PSL 规程或成员机构章程中未发现中央教学指引。

security_procurement.en: Central IT security review protocols, vendor assessment criteria, and institutional procurement standards for third-party artificial intelligence tools are not established in current public records.
security_procurement.zh: 针对第三方人工智能工具的中央 IT 安全审查规程、供应商评估标准及校级采购规范在当前公开记录中尚未确立。
security_procurement.meaningEn: No central IT procurement or enterprise AI vendor evaluation policy found in reviewed PSL sources.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 在已审核的 PSL 来源中未发现中央 IT 采购或企业级 AI 供应商评估政策。

topicBasis.coursework: In programmes PSL operates directly, AI tools may be used only where the instructor authorises them, and their use must then be disclosed. Member institutions (ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and others) apply their own regulations; for example the CIENS centre at ENS-PSL allows AI only as occasional help (translation, document exploration, organising work) and bans AI-written text content.
topicBasis.exams: The reviewed PSL sources do not set a general AI rule for examinations beyond anti-fraud measures; follow each programme's exam rules and instructor authorisation. This is an evidence gap, not a permission.
topicBasis.disclosure: Where an instructor authorises AI, its use must be disclosed explicitly like any source citation; undisclosed use is treated as plagiarism. Doctoral candidates must include a signed 'Déclaration doctorale d'intégrité scientifique' listing AI tools, tasks, benefits, limits and risks. CIENS requires AI use to be noted in a note or the text.
topicBasis.privacy_data: CIENS prohibits giving AI sensitive, protected or confidential information. Dauphine-PSL library guidance advises not sharing personal data with third parties and checking that generated text contains no personal data. No PSL-wide AI data rule was found in the reviewed sources.
topicBasis.approved_tools: No PSL-wide list of approved or licensed AI tools was found in the reviewed sources. ChatGPT is mentioned only as an example of an AI tool, not as a required or provided service.
topicBasis.research_publication: Generative AI is not prohibited in PSL doctoral research, but uses must be transparent, declared and critically assessed; the candidate remains fully responsible and member institutions may set stricter rules. Dauphine-PSL library guidance recommends stating the tool, version and context, not treating AI as a co-author, and notes reproducibility risks; these are recommendations at a member institution.
topicBasis.academic_integrity: Failure to disclose AI use is treated and sanctioned as plagiarism. On suspicion, the instructor informs the programme management and a disciplinary procedure may follow, with sanctions up to exclusion (not automatic). At CIENS, undeclared AI use may be treated as academic fraud.

do.en: In programmes PSL operates directly, use AI tools only where authorised by the instructor, and cite them like any source reference.
do.zh: 在 PSL 直接运营的项目中，只有在教师授权时才可使用 AI 工具，且须像引用任何来源一样予以标注。

do.en: Doctoral candidates: sign the 'Déclaration doctorale d'intégrité scientifique' at the front of the thesis, listing AI tools, tasks and risks.
do.zh: 博士生：在论文前页签署《博士科研诚信声明》，列明 AI 工具、任务和风险。

do.en: Check your member institution's or centre's own AI rules (for example the CIENS charter at ENS-PSL).
do.zh: 查看所在成员机构或中心自己的 AI 规则（如高师 CIENS 章程）。

dont.en: In programmes PSL operates directly, do not leave AI use undisclosed: it is treated as plagiarism and can lead to disciplinary sanctions.
dont.zh: 在 PSL 直接运营的项目中，不要隐瞒 AI 使用：会按剽窃处理，并可能导致纪律处分。

dont.en: At CIENS, do not use AI to write text content, build your research problem or produce references.
dont.zh: 在 CIENS，不要用 AI 撰写正文、构建研究问题或生成参考文献。

dont.en: Do not provide sensitive, protected or confidential information to AI tools (prohibited at CIENS, ENS-PSL), and avoid sharing personal data with public AI services (advised by Paris-Dauphine Library); follow member-institution data guidance.
dont.zh: 切勿向 AI 工具提供敏感、受保护或机密信息（ENS-PSL 的 CIENS 明确禁止），并避免向公开 AI 服务提供个人数据（巴黎九大图书馆建议）；请遵守各成员机构的数据指引。

draft-claim-psl-ciens-ai-charter.text: The AI charter of CIENS (an interdisciplinary centre of ENS-PSL) applies to CIENS students, teachers and researchers only. It allows generative AI as occasional help for translation, document exploration, exploratory document analysis or organising work, but prohibits producing false references, developing a research problem and scientific reasoning, writing the text content, and giving AI sensitive, protected or confidential information. Any AI use must be stated in a note or the body of the text, naming the tool and the nature of use; undeclared use may be treated as academic fraud and lead to disciplinary sanctions. These are unit-level rules, not PSL-wide rules.

evidence.quote: Cette charte vise à encadrer l’utilisation des IAg de manière éthique, responsable et durable pour les étudiants du CIENS mais aussi ses enseignants et ses chercheurs.
evidence.location: Introduction; lines 109-109 of captured page text

evidence.quote: Ces outils peuvent constituer une aide ponctuelle dans certaines étapes du travail telles que la traduction, l’exploration documentaire, l’analyse exploratoire de documents ou encore l’organisation du travail. Cependant, ils ne se substituent en aucun cas à l’effort intellectuel et à la réflexion personnelle qui doivent être fournis.
evidence.location: Usages autorisés; lines 135-135 of captured page text

evidence.quote:
Production de fausses références
Élaborer une problématique et un raisonnement scientifique
Rédiger le contenu textuel
Fournir à l’IAg des informations sensibles, protégées et confidentielles.
evidence.location: Usages interdits; lines 139-145 of captured page text

evidence.quote: Tout recours à un outil d’intelligence artificielle doit être mentionné par une note ou dans le corps du texte ; l’outil utilisé ainsi que la nature de l’usage qui en a été fait doivent être précisés.
evidence.location: Exigence de transparence; lines 151-151 of captured page text

evidence.quote: L’usage non déclaré de l’IAG est susceptible d’être considéré comme une fraude académique. Des sanctions disciplinaires peuvent être appliquées.
evidence.location: Exigence de transparence; lines 153-153 of captured page text

draft-claim-psl-doctoral-charter-genai.text: PSL's Charte du doctorat (June 2026, section 2.7) sets general recommendations on generative AI for doctoral candidates, some of which are mandatory. Generative AI is not prohibited in doctoral research, but its uses must be transparent, declared and critically assessed, and the candidate remains fully responsible for AI-obtained content. Candidates must insert a dated, signed 'Déclaration doctorale d'intégrité scientifique' (one to two pages) at the start of the thesis, stating which generative AI tools were used, for which tasks, their benefits, limits and risks, and any mitigation. Member institutions may set stricter rules, which prevail.

evidence.quote: L’Université PSL formule un cadre de recommandations générales relatives aux usages de l’intelligence artificielle générative (I.A.G.) dont certaines dispositions sont obligatoires pour les étudiants réalisant leur doctorat dans cette Université.
evidence.location: 2.7 Usages de l'intelligence artificielle générative; physical PDF page 7; lines 254-256 of captured PDF text

evidence.quote: Il s’ensuit que l’utilisation de l’I.A.G. n’est pas interdite dans le contexte d’une recherche doctorale, mais les usages, à l’instar d’autres outils, doivent être transparents, déclarés et faire l’objet d’un retour critique de la part du doctorant.
evidence.location: 2.7; physical PDF page 8; lines 296-298 of captured PDF text

evidence.quote: Les établissements-composantes sont susceptibles de définir des règles plus précises en matière d'I.A.G., qui prévaudront.
evidence.location: 2.7; physical PDF page 8; lines 293-294 of captured PDF text

evidence.quote: Dans le cadre de ce doctorat, j’ai utilisé les outils d’intelligence artificielle générative <préciser ces outils ici> pour la tâche <préciser les tâches> avec les avantages et limites suivantes <préciser et discuter les avantages et limites et risques associés>
evidence.location: 2.7 Déclaration doctorale d'intégrité scientifique; physical PDF page 8; lines 314-316 of captured PDF text

evidence.quote: Cette déclaration doit être datée et signée par le doctorant et insérée dans les premières pages du manuscrit de doctorat.
evidence.location: 2.7; physical PDF page 8; lines 321-322 of captured PDF text

psl-claim-central-ai-disclosure.text: Université PSL's Règlement de la scolarité for 2026-2027 (adopted by the Board on 25 June 2026, replacing the June 2025 version with the same AI wording) states that, where an instructor authorises AI-based tools such as ChatGPT, their use must be explicitly disclosed like any source citation, and failure to disclose AI use is treated as plagiarism and sanctioned as such; a disciplinary procedure may follow, with sanctions up to exclusion (not automatic exclusion). The 2026 version applies to programmes operated directly by PSL (such as the Collège Sciences, Humanités et Société and the Paris School of AI); member institutions apply their own regulations, so it does not set course permissions across ENS, Dauphine, Mines Paris and other members.

evidence.quote: Le présent règlement s'applique aux formations directement opérées par l'Université PSL (Collège Sciences, Humanités et Société, Paris School of AI, …).
evidence.location: Préambule (CA du 25 juin 2026); physical PDF page 2; lines 6-7 of captured PDF text

evidence.quote: Lorsque celui-ci est autorisé par l’enseignante ou l’enseignant, le recours à des outils basés sur l’intelligence artificielle (IA), tels que ChatGPT, doit être signalé explicitement (de la même manière que toute référence ou citation de source). Ne pas signaler l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle est considéré comme un acte de plagiat et sera sanctionné comme tel.
evidence.location: Article 3 – Intégrité académique, Plagiat; physical PDF page 3; lines 94-97 of captured PDF text

evidence.quote: En cas de soupçon de plagiat, l’enseignante ou l’enseignant doit informer l’équipe de direction et lui communiquer tous les éléments à disposition. Une procédure disciplinaire peut être déclenchée avec une sanction pouvant aller jusqu’à l’exclusion.
evidence.location: Article 3 – Intégrité académique, Plagiat; physical PDF page 3; lines 99-101 of captured PDF text

psl-claim-research-data-privacy.text: The Dauphine-PSL library's research-integrity guidance states that personal data are not meant to be shared with third parties and that generated text should be checked so it is neither plagiarism nor contains personal data. This is member-institution library guidance.

evidence.quote: Outre les questions de confidentialité des productions scientifiques, les données personnelles n’ont pas vocation à être partagées avec des tiers. Dans le cadre des réponses obtenues, il faut vérifier que le texte généré ne constitue pas un plagiat ou ne contient pas de données personnelles.
evidence.location: Confidentialité et données personnelles; physical PDF page 3; lines 98-101 of captured PDF text

psl-claim-research-limitations.text: The Dauphine-PSL library's guidance notes that generative AI undermines research reproducibility, a basic principle of scientific integrity, because models' code and algorithms may be unknown and change regularly. This is a risk statement, not a prohibition on AI use.

evidence.quote: La reproductibilité de la recherche est un principe de base de l’intégrité scientifique. Or ce principe est mis à mal par l’utilisation de l’IA.
evidence.location: Reproductibilité; physical PDF page 2; lines 48-49 of captured PDF text

psl-claim-research-responsibility.text: The Dauphine-PSL library's research-integrity guidance advises keeping a critical approach to AI tools, not treating them as co-authors, and not using them to create scientific materials that could be falsified. It is advisory library guidance at a member institution, not a PSL-wide administrative prohibition.

evidence.quote: il faut garder une approche critique de ces outils, connaître leurs biais et leurs limites (hallucinations, approximation), ne pas les considérer comme des co-auteurs et ne pas les utiliser pour créer des matériaux scientifiques, qui pourraient être falsifiés.
evidence.location: Autorat et responsabilité scientifique; physical PDF page 2; lines 84-87 of captured PDF text

psl-claim-research-transparency.text: Research-integrity guidance published by the Université Paris Dauphine-PSL library recommends that researchers who use generative AI state the tool, its version and the context of use, and notes that prompts and results may also be documented. This is library guidance for researchers at a PSL member institution, not a PSL-wide mandatory rule.

evidence.quote: si une IA générative est utilisée, il faut indiquer l’outil utilisé, sa version et le cadre de cette utilisation. Le prompt et le résultat peuvent également être documentés.
evidence.location: Utiliser l'IA générative de manière raisonnée et intègre; physical PDF page 2; lines 88-90 of captured PDF text
